observation.visible_scene: A fixed view of a dense coniferous forest (tall pointed spruces with a few broadleaf crowns) enveloped in pale mist, with thin vertical rain streaks falling through the air. The foreground and mid-ground trees are sharp and green; the background trees fade into the fog.
visible_changes: Bright vertical rain streaks continuously move downward across the frame from one sample to the next, appearing at the top and descending past the tree crowns, indicating ongoing rainfall rather than a single event.

The mist on the left side and in the upper background gradually thickens and brightens over the excerpt, washing out the left edge and the distant tree line more than at the start, while the right-hand trees stay relatively clear.

The trees and the overall framing hold constant positions from the first to the last frame; there is no evident camera pan, tilt, or zoom, and the prominent central and right spruces remain in the same place throughout.
No clear displacement or deformation of individual branches is visible; the foliage appears essentially static apart from the passing rain and fog.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the rain and fog intensify, weaken, or stop before or after this cropped segment.
Any wind or branch movement outside the resolution of these frames.
uncertain_details: Subtle branch sway cannot be reliably distinguished from image compression and the moving mist.
The apparent leftward fog buildup could be a slow drift or simply fluctuating mist density; direction is not firmly established.
Camera motion is treated as negligible because background tree positions stay aligned, but very small drift cannot be fully excluded.
